name: lcdwizard-copilot
description: Community MIT extension that gives Copilot project-aware LCD Wizard guidance and board/server integration context.

lcdWizardCopilot.projectFile.description: Optional path to the LCD Wizard .slw.json file, relative to its workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: lcdwizard_project_report
languageModelTools.userDescription: Summarizes LCD Wizard project structure with setting defaults and likely secrets omitted.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the selected LCD Wizard .slw.json and summarize its target, hardware, screens/widgets, variables, bindings, settings, automations, and data sources. This tool is read-only and omits setting defaults and likely secrets. Call before giving project-specific LCD Wizard advice.

languageModelTools.name: lcdwizard_connectivity_context
languageModelTools.userDescription: Summarizes the selected LCD Wizard transport settings and finds likely firmware/server entry points in the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Summarize the selected LCD Wizard target, configured Web data and Bluetooth roles, plus likely generated firmware and server entry-point files in the workspace. Link to official transport/export documentation. Do not claim compatibility or live behavior from file presence alone.

languageModelTools.name: lcdwizard_docs
languageModelTools.userDescription: Finds official LCD Wizard documentation topics for project settings and generated code.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return brief original topic summaries and official LCD Wizard documentation links. Do not invent undocumented project behavior.

topic.description: Topic name such as settings, variables, bindings, automations, Bluetooth, export, or all.

chatParticipants.name: lcdwizard
chatParticipants.description: Ask about LCD Wizard projects, settings, variables, bindings, automations, hardware, exports, and server integration.
